canary.unavailable: Validation unavailable — this deployment has no live LLM for the canary to run.
canary.queued: Queued — waiting for the validation worker to pick this up (usually within a minute).
canary.running: Validating now — running a real-model safety check over the full scenario set. This typically takes ~20–30 minutes and continues in the background. You can keep this page open or come back later — the verdict (safe, or the list of regressions) will replace this message right here when it finishes.
canary.pollError: Could not refresh the status just now — the validation is still running in the background and this will retry automatically.
canary.ok: No regression — this prompt stays within tolerance of the baseline.

guidance.persona_style_rules: Shapes how your personas WRITE — greeting, tone, name-handling, signing, anti-repetition — on every reply. These rules are SHARED by every persona and applied on top of each persona's own character: the persona's description (edit it on the Personas screen) is WHO they are; this block is the house writing style layered on top. Safety rules (never leak a channel, stay on email, careful-buyer, language) are enforced separately in code and cannot be relaxed here. Because it drives every reply, you can Validate a change before activating it.
guidance.conversation_director_strategy: Shapes the Conversation Director's STRATEGY — how it infers this scam's goal and varies each reply's shape so messages don't read alike. The Director is the 'brain' that plans each turn; this block tunes its planning. The JSON output contract, the anti-unmask / never-re-ask rule, hostile-scammer detection and language fidelity are locked in code and cannot be edited here. Because it drives every reply, you can Validate a change before activating it.
guidance.conversation_director_tone: Sets the Conversation Director's TONE palette — the emotional register it recommends as the exchange progresses (worried → suspicious → reassured → confident → annoyed → direct). Only this palette is editable; the output contract and every safety rule stay locked in code. Because it drives every reply, you can Validate a change before activating it.
guidance.contextual_enrichment: Runs during IOC extraction to classify each indicator the scammer reveals (role, stimulus, urgency). A weak override degrades IOC typing and the CTI output.
guidance.reward_judge: Runs when a conversation closes to score its outcome. This reward trains the persona-selection bandit, so a poor rubric skews which personas get chosen.
